market_summary: Roligt marked uden akutte makro-katalysatorer; fokus er porteføljepleje frem mod en tæt cluster af Q-regnskaber (ISS 11/8, VWS 12/8, RBREW 17/8, COLO-B 18/8, ALSYDB 26/8). Coloplast er tæt på sit kursmål og faar hævet stop for at beskytte gevinsten. Ingen nye køb i dag: Healthcare udgør allerede 36.2% af porteføljen (primært NOVO-B alene paa 30.2%), og de eneste nye BULL-kandidater uden position (GMAB, ROCK-B) er enten en yderligere Healthcare-forøgelse eller ekstremt overkøbt (RSI 76, Stoch 100) uden teknisk bekræftelse.

decisions.name: Royal Unibrew
decisions.reasoning: Staerk indtjeningsvaekst (+40% YoY) og billig vaerdiansaettelse fortsaetter, men kursen er endnu ikke bekraeftet over SMA200. Fastholder position og stop uaendret frem mod Q-regnskabet 17/8.
bull: Earnings growth of 40% YoY with a cheap forward PE of 12.7x
3.3% dividend yield plus active share buyback and capital-reduction program
bear: Still 26% below its 52-week high and slightly under its 200-day average

investment_plan.thesis: Vaerdi/vaekst-kombination der endnu ikke er teknisk bekraeftet (under SMA200). Stop fastholdes ved 470 for at beskytte den opnaaede gevinst frem mod Q-regnskabet.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 470. Tag profit naer SMA200 (502). Reducer ved Q-rapport 17/8 med omsaetningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: ISS
decisions.reasoning: Dybt oversolgt (RSI 24, stoch 11) med flad organisk vaekst. Q-regnskab 11/8 er en naer-forestaaende test af thesis; ingen stop-brud og ingen fundamental aendring, saa positionen fastholdes uaendret gennem regnskabet.
bull: Deeply oversold (RSI 24, stochastic 11.4, near the lower Bollinger band) — potential bounce setup
Still 52% above its 52-week low, forward PE 12.5x reasonable, ongoing buyback provides support
bear: Down 3.5% over 5 days with earnings and revenue growth essentially flat

investment_plan.thesis: Saelden trifecta af positive katalysatorer, men flad organisk vaekst begraenser opsiden. Q-regnskab 11/8 er en naer-forestaaende test.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 265. Tag profit naer 320. Revurder ved skuffende Q-regnskab 11/8 eller vedvarende flad omsaetningsvaekst.

decisions.name: Coloplast B
decisions.reasoning: Kort-sigtet uptrend (RSI 60) og attraktivt udbytte fortsaetter, positionen naermer sig kursmaal 450 (+10.3% p.t.). Haever stop fra 405 til 420 for at laase mere af gevinsten ind frem mod Q-regnskab 18/8.
bull: Short-term uptrend building (RSI 60, +9.6% vs SMA50) with a 5.4% dividend yield drawing value-investor attention
Cited by a prominent value investor as an example of cheap, high-yield global stocks
bear: Still 32% below its 52-week high and below its 200-day average (-7.3%)

investment_plan.thesis: Deep-value sundhedsnavn med et regulatorisk katalysator og velbegrundet udbytte. Naer target, stop haevet til 420 for at beskytte den opnaaede gevinst frem mod Q-regnskabet.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 420. Tag profit naer 450. Revurder ved Q-regnskab 18/8 hvis SMA200-afstanden fortsat udvides uden fundamental bedring.

decisions.name: Danske Bank
decisions.reasoning: Opjusteret helaarsguidance og sund uptrend (RSI 64, SMA200 +21.5%) understoetter thesis fortsat. Fastholdes uaendret for at undgaa yderligere koncentration i Financial Services.
bull: 2026 net profit guidance raised to DKK 23-25bn
Steady uptrend (RSI 64, SMA200 +21.5%) backed by an ongoing weekly buyback
4.49% dividend yield
bear: Trading near its 52-week high (-0.6%), leaving limited near-term technical room
Broader bond market volatility around inflation data could pressure bank sentiment

investment_plan.thesis: Staerke H1-resultater med opjusteret helaarsguidance, understoettet af en sund uptrend. Fastholdes uaendret for at undgaa yderligere koncentration i Financial Services-sektoren.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 350. Tag profit naer 400. Revurder ved guidance-nedjustering eller brud i kreditkvaliteten.

decisions.name: Vestas Wind Systems
decisions.reasoning: Eksplosiv indtjeningsvaekst (+1516% YoY) understoetter turnaround-thesis, men teknisk endnu ikke bekraeftet (RSI 45). Overvaages taet op til Q-regnskab 12/8; stop uaendret.
bull: Major earnings turnaround (+1516% YoY) with revenue up 14.4%
New project wins (Latvia wind/battery) and a completed share buyback program
Well positioned within the AI-power-demand theme
bear: Technical momentum still neutral (RSI 45), not yet confirmed
Forward PE 16.1x is not particularly cheap for the sector

investment_plan.thesis: Tidlig fundamental turnaround: eksplosiv indtjeningsvaekst signalerer at ordreindtag og marginer er ved at vende. Teknisk endnu ikke bekraeftet og handler taet paa stop-loss foran Q-regnskab 12/8 - overvaages dagligt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 163 (taet paa nuvaerende pris - overvaag dagligt). Tag profit naer 205. Revurder hvis indtjeningsvaeksten viser sig enkeltstaaende ved kvartalsrapport 12/8.

decisions.name: Sydbank
decisions.reasoning: Billig vaerdiansaettelse og staerkt momentum (RSI 66, SMA200 +17.6%) fortsaetter, men marginpres skal afklares ved naeste regnskab 26/8. Fastholdes uaendret.
bull: Steady uptrend: RSI 66, price 17.6% above its 200-day average
Ongoing weekly share buyback program signals management confidence
Forward PE 10.4x is cheap with a 3.9% dividend yield
bear: Trading near its 52-week high (-0.6%), limiting near-term upside room

investment_plan.thesis: Kombination af billig vaerdiansaettelse og staerkt momentum, men marginpres er en reel risiko der skal afklares ved naeste regnskab 26/8.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 600. Tag profit naer 680. Revurder hvis marginpresset forvaerres yderligere uden stabilisering, eller ved svag kvartalsrapport 26/8.

decisions.name: Novo Nordisk B
decisions.reasoning: Antitrust-sejr og billig vaerdiansaettelse er positivt, men konkurrencen fra Eli Lilly haarder til. Positionen er allerede 30.2% af porteføljen - ingen tilkoeb, kun overvaagning af koncentrationsrisiko.
bull: Up 3.9% today after winning a key GLP-1 antitrust ruling (Texas judge dismissed claims)
5.42% dividend yield and cheap forward PE of 14.0x for the growth profile
bear: CEO is resetting growth expectations for Wegovy just as Eli Lilly widens its lead with 91% Mounjaro growth
Stock is 25.6% below its 52-week high with earnings still contracting (-20.6%)

investment_plan.thesis: Deep-value-position i en kvalitets-GLP-1-leder efter et bekraeftet Q2-regnskab med guidance-opjustering. Positionen er nu fuldt udbygget til 30.2% af porteføljen - ingen yderligere tilkoeb, kun overvaagning af koncentrationsrisiko.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 285. Tag profit naer 345. Revurder ved nye pipeline-skuffelser eller accelereret GLP-1-markedsandelstab til Lilly.

decisions.name: DSV
decisions.reasoning: Rekord-EBIT og opjusteret guidance staar i kontrast til den svage tekniske udvikling (RSI 18, Zacks 'Bear of the Day'). Mean-reversion-thesis er intakt, stop ikke ramt - fastholdes uaendret.
bull: RSI 17.9 and stochastic 8.5 are deeply oversold — classic bounce-candidate setup
Record EBIT reported in Q2 with raised guidance and Schenker integration progressing
Forward PE 15.9x is far cheaper than the 44.8x trailing multiple
bear: Zacks flagged DSV as its 'Bear of the Day', citing a weakened near-term investment case
Down 18.7% over 20 days and trading well below both SMA50 (-13.1%) and SMA200 (-14.2%)

investment_plan.thesis: Kontrarisk indgang i en kvalitetslogistikaktoer efter et fundamentalt staerkt Q2-regnskab blev overskygget af negativ sentiment. Ekstrem oversolgt teknik plus rimelig forward-vaerdiansaettelse giver attraktivt risk/reward for en mean-reversion.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 1212 (2x ATR stop). Tag profit naer 1550 (SMA50-genobring). Revurder hvis den institutionelle salgsvolumen fortsaetter uden stabilisering, eller ved svaghed i naeste regnskab 21/10.
